## Kit doctrine map

| # | Anti-pattern | Kit rule / pattern |
|---|--------------|--------------------|
| 1 | Luxury costume | Dense Linear/Raycast; no gold/serif marketing chrome |
| 2 | Gradient overload | Ban purple/indigo AI gradients |
| 3 | Fake depth / glass | Hairlines over drop shadows; no glassmorphism for its own sake |
| 4 | Random 3D hero | Real product / status over illustrations |
| 5 | Over-animated | Motion 120–200ms; stream reveals, no bounce loaders |
| 6 | Spacing without rhythm | Token spacing; dense vertical rhythm |
| 7 | Typography without hierarchy | Token type scale; monospace for IDs/args |
| 8 | Reference soup | One composition; don’t blend opposing AI skins |
| 9 | No content logic | Concrete agent status / diffs over adjective cards |
| 10 | Decorative feature icons | Prefer live counters, steps, budgets over icon rows |
| Bonus | Inter/Roboto defaults · SVG stock people · callout left-stripe | Kit font stack; real assets; no soft SaaS callout chrome |

Full protocol: kit root `.cursorrules` · `AI-INSTRUCTIONS.md`.
